stem.text: A car of weight $15\,000\,\text{N}$ is travelling along a horizontal road.

stem.alt: Diagram of a car on a horizontal road with a resistive force arrow to the left labelled 3000 N, a thrust force arrow to the right labelled 12000 N, and a velocity arrow to the right labelled 24 m s-1.

stem.text: At one instant, the thrust force acting on the car from the engine is $12\,000\,\text{N}$ and the resistive force acting on the car is $3000\,\text{N}$. The velocity of the car at this instant is $24\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What is the power output from the engine?
